title: A/R Collection: a customer ticked by link is named even if hard to find
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the organization has more than 50 customers (the Customer menu lists at most 50 until you search), and customer A, who has overdue invoices on today's date, comes after the first 50 in name order.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. In the Customer filter, search for customer A.
  2. Tick customer A.
  3. Copy the page address.
  4. Open a new browser tab.
  5. Paste the copied address into its address bar.
  6. Press Enter.
  7. Open the Customer menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A shows in the list.

Step 2:

  • The chip reads "Customer: " and customer A's name.

Step 3:

  • The address is copied.

Step 4:

  • A new, empty tab opens.

Step 5:

  • The copied address shows in the address bar.

Step 6:

  • The report opens with only customer A's group.
  • The chip reads "Customer: " and customer A's name.

Step 7:

  • Customer A is shown ticked in the menu.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R14: “A customer or vendor ticked through a link, a reload or a Summary drill-down is named and ticked on the chip, even when it is not among the first results of the chip's search.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D31: “Customer search (ar-aging/customers) searches all of the organization's customers, as Sales By Customer's chip does; vendor list = all of the organization's vendors, as Inventory Value's chip does”
  • Tech plan §5 API, new endpoints: “ar-aging/customers (search, limit ≤ 50), ap-aging/vendors (org vendor list)”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.
